name: ChadNext
summary: Next.js 15 App Router starter with shadcn/ui, LuciaAuth, Prisma, Server Actions, Stripe and i18n.
description: A quick starter template for Next.js projects: Next.js 15 App Router with shadcn/ui, LuciaAuth authentication, Prisma database, Server Actions, Stripe, internationalization, and more. Set up with pnpm install, copy .env.example to .env, run pnpm prisma db push, then pnpm dev. MIT licensed.
